principle.otherModules: Other EBP modules (building, maintenance…): add their prefix to EBP_PROXY_PREFIXES. Read cache can be bypassed with ?noCache=1.
principle.p1: Applications call the gateway. It centralises EBP authentication, quota throttling and logging. You handle neither EBP ClientId/Secret nor subscription key: the gateway resolves the EBP account and folder from your app token.
principle.p2: Transparent proxy: any request — GET as well as writes (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) — whose path starts with an allowed EBP prefix is relayed as-is to EBP, bar the FolderId. We reinvent no endpoint: we remain a gateway.
principle.title: Call the gateway, not EBP directly
